source_text: Ι. Βουληϑέντι σοι zart ἀχρίβειαν ἐχμαϑεῖν τὰ προτεϑέντα ὑπι σοῦ ἡμῖν κεφάλαια, ἀγαπητέ μου ἀδελφὲ Θεόφιλε, εὔλογον ἡγησάμην, ἀφϑόνως ἀρυσάμενος ὡς ἐὲ ἁγίας πηγῆς ἐξ αὐτῶν τῶν ϑείων γραφῶν καταστῆσαί σοι κατ᾽ ὀφϑαλμὸν τὰ ζητούμενα" ἵνα μὴ μόνον ταῖς τῶν ὥτων ἀχοαῖς ἐγκαταϑέμενος ταῦτα εὐφρανϑῆς, ἀλλὰ δυνάμει καὶ αὐτὰ τὰ πράγϊματα ἐνιστορήσας κατὰ πάντα τὸν ϑεὸν δοξάσαι δυνηϑῆς. τοῦτο γάρ σοι ἐφόϊδιον ἐν τῷ νῦν βίῳ ἀκίνδυνον ἤτω παρ᾽ ἡμῶν, ὅπως τὰ τοῖς πολλοῖς δύσγνωστα καὶ δυσχατάλημπτα ἐξ ἕτοίμῶν λόγων προενέγκας. ἐγκατασπείρης μὲν ἐν τῷ πλάτει τῆς καρδίας σου ὡς ἐν πίονι καὶ καϑαρᾷ γῇ, δυσωπήσῃς δὲ di αὐτῶν τοὺς ἀντιδιατιϑεμένους καὶ ἀντιλέγοντας τῷ σωτηρίῳ λόγῳ.
pass_a_gloss: Having been wished by you to learn the precision of the things proposed by you to us, beloved my brother Theophilus, I considered it reasonable, having drawn abundantly as from a holy source from the divine scriptures themselves, to place before your eyes the things being sought, so that not only having been entrusted to the hearings of the ears, you may be delighted by these things, but also having been instructed by the power of the things themselves, you may be able to glorify God in every way. For this may be a provision for you in the present life, safe with us, so that having brought forth from prepared words the things unknown and hard to grasp by many, you may sow them in the breadth of your heart as in fertile and pure land, and you may despise those who contradict and speak against the saving word.
pass_b_english: Since you wanted to learn the precise details of the topics you proposed to us, my beloved brother Theophilus, I thought it right to draw abundantly from the divine Scriptures themselves as from a holy spring and set before your eyes the things you seek. I do this so that you may not only be delighted by hearing these things with your ears, but also, having been instructed by the power of the matters themselves, you may be able to glorify God in every way. May this serve as a safe provision for you in the present life, so that, bringing forward from prepared words the things that are unknown and hard for many to grasp, you may sow them in the breadth of your heart as in fertile and pure soil, and despise those who contradict and speak against the saving word.

anf_compare.notes: Drafted from source only; ANF not shown to drafter.

review.notes: The translation accurately reflects the Greek text. Pass A preserves the passive construction of the opening clause (Βουληϑέντι σοι), while Pass B provides a more fluent rendering (Since you wanted) which is acceptable under the rules. Both correctly identify the recipient (Theophilus) and the purpose of the text. All clauses, including the metaphors of the fertile land and the warning against those who contradict the saving word, are present and accurate.
